{"metadata":{"description":"Live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem - every node, edge and state is the real Cordis runtime","id":"gh:1339004426","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-3d-plugin-graph","slug":"jelly-000/dsh-3d-plugin-graph","topics":["3d-graph","cordis","dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","plugin-graph","real-time","visualization"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem - every node, edge and state is the real Cordis ru"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem - every node, edge and state is the real Cordis runtime"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-3d-plugin-graph"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> A live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem. Every node, edge and state you see is the rea"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"l Cordis runtime — nothing is mocked."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文 README"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What is it?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH (DeepSeek Harness) is itself an ecosystem of **170+ Cordis plugins**. This plugin opens a window"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" into that ecosystem: it reads the running Cordis runtime and renders the live plugin topology as an"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" interactive 3D graph you can orbit, zoom, drag and operate."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Nodes** are real runtime plugins (loader entries / registry fibers).
- **Edges** are real depend"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ency relations (service providers from the reflect store × inject declarations on each fiber; the ar"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"row points at the dependency).
- **States** are the real fiber state machine (active / pending / loa"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ding / error / disabled / unloading), refreshed every 2 s — drag a node around and watch its neighbo"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"urs follow; unplug a plugin from the graph itself and see the whole neighbourhood react.
- **Activit"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"y** streams from real `tools/result` events — when a tool runs, white light motes travel along the a"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ffected edges in real time."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Real runtime data
- Nodes / edges / services / tool surface all come from the live runtime (`ctx"},{"id":"p9s2","text":".loader.entries()`, `ctx.reflect.store`, `ctx.tools.schemas()`, `tools/result` events); the UI merge"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"s state polls without ever moving your dragged nodes.
- Graceful degradation: with no reachable sour"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ce it falls back to an offline demo so the UI is never a blank page."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Interaction
- **Orbit / pan / zoom**: drag empty space to orbit (bounded pitch), Shift / right-d"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"rag to pan, wheel to zoom **anchored at the node under the cursor** (it stays glued to the cursor), "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"double-click a node to focus, `R` to reset, `Esc` to close.
- **Node dragging with physics**: nodes "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"are solid bodies — dragging one pushes others out of the way (velocity-impulse collision), and sprin"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"g edges pull connected nodes along. Release and the graph settles back into balance.
- **Label LOD**"},{"id":"p10s6","text":": far away only the core label shows; labels fade in as you zoom; occluded labels hide automatically"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" (8px type, occlusion-aware)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Operations & safety
- **Unplug requires double confirmation**: arming it shows the cascade impac"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"t count, the list of affected dependents, and a dedicated warning when the plugin is part of a depen"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"dency cycle — because unplugging a mutual dependency can destabilise the harness itself.
- **No auto"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" re-insertion**: unplug is a real `entry.update({disabled:true})`; nothing silently re-inserts a plu"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"gin later.
- **Server-side guards**: core infrastructure (loader / include / isolate), the graph plu"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"gin itself, and any operation whose cascade would hit the graph are refused server-side, not just hi"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"dden in the UI.
- **Re-plug is one click** (re-enabling is safe), with live state flip on the next p"},{"id":"p11s8","text":" in the UI.
- **Re-plug is one click** (re-enabling is safe), with live state flip on the next poll."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Activity & status
- Live tool-execution log (all / errors only) with connection-state pill.
- Ru"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ntime flow effects: white motes on active edges, red motes for failed calls; pulse animation when a "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"plugin's state changes."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### UI / UX / performance
- Single-file UI (`assets/index.html`), zero external dependencies, no CDN"},{"id":"p13s2","text":", no build step.
- 170-node synthetic load (state churn + event stream + drag): **mean frame gap ≈ 1"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"7 ms** in the automated perf test — no long hitches.
- Accessibility: `prefers-reduced-motion` suppo"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"rt, `focus-visible` outlines, `aria-live` announcements, `color-scheme: dark`.
- Dark, restrained vi"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"sual language: white node surfaces, state-only accent colours, deep background."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Security posture
- CSP meta tag (`default-src 'self'`), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `esc("},{"id":"p14s2","text":")` on every server-originated string that touches `innerHTML`.
- Adversarial test suite: XSS payload"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s through popup / confirm / panel / search, prototype-pollution keys, malformed state payloads — all"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"/ confirm / panel / search, prototype-pollution keys, malformed state payloads — all asserted inert."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requires a DSH installation with a web profile."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Then restart the web profile (or let HMR pick it up). For local development you can point `add` at a"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" directory instead of a URL."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Once installed, open the DSH web UI — a floating **「插件图谱」** entry appears bottom-right. Or access di"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"stalled, open the DSH web UI — a floating **「插件图谱」** entry appears bottom-right. Or access directly:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| What | URL |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| The graph UI | `http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-3d-plugin-graph/` |
| Live state JSON | `http://"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-3d-plugin-graph/state` |
| Enable / disable a plugin | `POST /plugins/dsh"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"-3d-plugin-graph/action` with `{"action":"plug"|"unplug","id":"plugin-xxx"}` |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Controls"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Input | Action |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Drag empty space | Orbit camera |
| Shift / right drag | Pan |
| Wheel | Zoom, anchored at cursor "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"|
| Drag a node | Move it (physics: collision + springs) |
| Click a node | Select → detail card |
|"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" Double-click a node | Focus it (camera converges) |
| Double-click empty space | Reset view |
| `R`"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" | Reset view |
| `Esc` | Close popup / confirmation |
| Search box (top right) | Fuzzy plugin searc"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"h, arrows + Enter to focus |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Full details in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — key decisions:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Drag resolves by id, not by closure**: event handlers look the node up at event time, so 2 s sta"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"te merges can never leave the pointer holding a ghost object.
- **Drag is isolated from physics**: t"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"he dragged node is excluded from collision, springs and drift while held; it stops exactly where you"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" drop it.
- **Real state only**: the graph never invents data; every status, edge and service is rea"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"d from the runtime.
- **Schema contract**: the `dsh_plugin_graph_status` tool output schema declares"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" every top-level key, so bind failures are impossible."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development & testing"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"All suites run against mock servers and real headless Chrome — no live DSH instance needed."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Repository layout"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
